subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core config surface now, and should its `minimal`, `standard`, and `full` semantics match this PR's root-only versus hook-extra split?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but choosing a new config/default surface affects prompt context, session behavior, hook extras, upgrade expectations, and overlapping bootstrap-control proposals.

options.title: Sponsor This Shape After Docs
options.body: Proceed with this PR as the focused additive config path after a current-base refresh and docs coverage for the new key and tier behavior.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Bootstrap Selection
options.body: Pause this PR and design one public selector contract for tiering, per-session filtering, hook extras, and prompt-pressure work together.

options.title: Decline The Config Knob
options.body: Keep fixed filters and steer users toward existing context injection, bootstrap budgets, lightweight mode, or doctor guidance instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor This Shape After Docs
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR as the focused additive config path after a current-base refresh and docs coverage for the new key and tier behavior.
